title: He Taught Me How to Walk

youtube_full.title: He Taught Me How to Walk | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Hosea 11:1–3
youtube_full.description:
He Taught Me How to Walk: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Hosea 11:1–3.

Hosea told how Heavenly Father loves His people, like a parent loves a child. He said, “When Israel was a child, I loved him.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Willow the Warm.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

2:55 Question time
